WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.ticket_id,
         se.to_status,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.ticket_id
                            ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.seq DESC) AS rn
  FROM ticket_events e
  JOIN ticket_status_events se
    ON se.event_id = e.event_id AND se.ticket_id = e.ticket_id
  WHERE e.occurred_at < '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT ticket_id
FROM ev
WHERE rn = 1 AND to_status IN ('open', 'pending')
ORDER BY ticket_id;

WITH cutoff(c) AS (VALUES ('2026-04-01 00:00:00')), last_status AS (SELECT e.ticket_id, se.to_status AS status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.ticket_id ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.seq DESC) AS rn FROM ticket_status_events se JOIN ticket_events e ON e.event_id = se.event_id WHERE e.occurred_at < (SELECT c FROM cutoff)), last_team AS (SELECT e.ticket_id, ae.to_team_id AS team_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.ticket_id ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.seq DESC) AS rn FROM ticket_assignment_events ae JOIN ticket_events e ON e.event_id = ae.event_id WHERE e.occurred_at < (SELECT c FROM cutoff)) SELECT et.team_id, COUNT(d.ticket_id) AS open_or_pending FROM (SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE created_at < (SELECT c FROM cutoff)) et LEFT JOIN (SELECT ls.ticket_id, lt.team_id FROM last_status ls JOIN last_team lt ON lt.ticket_id = ls.ticket_id JOIN ticket_statuses ts ON ts.status_code = ls.status WHERE ls.rn = 1 AND lt.rn = 1 AND ts.counts_as_backlog = 1) d ON d.team_id = et.team_id GROUP BY et.team_id ORDER BY et.team_id;

SELECT DISTINCT tse.ticket_id FROM ticket_status_events AS tse JOIN ticket_events AS te ON te.event_id = tse.event_id AND te.ticket_id = tse.ticket_id WHERE tse.from_status = 'closed' AND tse.to_status IN ('open', 'pending') AND te.occurred_at >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND te.occurred_at < '2026-04-01 00:00:00' ORDER BY tse.ticket_id;
